source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_powerModule" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i power (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the power-module OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_powerModule SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Read power-module presence, health, redundancy and approved electrical telemetry through SNMPv3 and compare to the platform baseline.
original_method: Engineer enables v3 and browses undefined `$target`; no module/field/range is specified.
manual_activity: Engineer configures WebUI/SNMPv3 and supplies the PSU/power-module matrix; read-only collection/comparison is automated.
safety_requirements: Read only; never toggle PSU, power cap or host power.
Protect v3 secrets and reject v2c substitution.
Safety-stop on real power fault or redundancy loss.
Preserve full typed data; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: After setup, query mapped modules, decode approved fields and correlate with BMC/host power health.
Do not control power or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve module/field/limit matrix and configure/restore v3.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Wrong security mode and generic grep cannot bind values to a PSU/module or establish units/redundancy.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact vendor power-module SNMPv3 objects with typed responses and slot mapping.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, `$target`, Net-SNMP criterion and 10/5-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Inventory each module/slot, collect presence/health/redundancy and approved voltage/current/power values, then compare limits and independent telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor power-module MIB and electrical limits.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Distinguishes healthy redundancy from mere data presence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Telemetry may lag rapid AC events.

project_override_considerations: Project can select a documented subset of electrical fields while preserving presence/health/redundancy coverage and reporting omissions.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria use different clients, `$target` is undefined, and DeepSeek changes v3 to a generic v2c power filter.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Module matrix, units and limits are project inputs. With manual configuration the read-only core is automatable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Corrects BLOCKED to PACKAGE under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps electrical safety while separating missing inputs from capability.

review_improvement: Binds every value to a power module, unit and redundancy expectation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The named monitoring scope is clear. Owner-provided mappings make telemetry deterministic; engineer configuration is manual setup before automated collection.
